steps.content: Bianca's hands are shaking so much that she can barely hold the camera, but she steadies the lens with both hands, adjusting her breathing.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Don't be afraid, you are the bravest... It's your dream to sacrifice everything for journalism, and today you finally get to realize it!

Bianca has received the last messages on the app. Obediently, she stays away from her phone. On the ground at the far end, the monster continues struggling out of the screen. She presses the record button tremulously and steps back on tiptoe, attempting to fulfill the Super Apple's last mission: Capture the definitive evidence.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Dear viewers, I am your reporter Bianca, and I am currently at the site where Mania has appeared in Eastside!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I have already evacuated the nearby residents and contacted a trustworthy investigator immediately! Although there are no eyewitnesses, I still hope you'll believe what you're seeing now is all real!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I just saw a monster crawl out of the screen when my Inferior vote count reached 90%. This confirms my previous speculation that the Gray Mirror app could devour people! It's very likely the cause of the recent disappearances!

No new notification sounds can be heard from her phone in the distance. As the digitalized Mania power leaks, traces of <color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>'s existence on the internet are being erased gradually.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Sob... I'm so sorry, Ashy! I dare not touch my phone now. I've used up all my courage sending you that video just now... You'll find the rest in the memory card.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I believe you'll come to save me! Because you believed my bold theories about Gray Mirror and you trusted the information I provided. You acted on just a scrap of the truth!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: If you're watching this video and you couldn't save me, it's okay! I won't blame you! I sacrificed myself for journalism. Bianca, the great journalist, has no regrets... Ahhh!
Before Bianca can utter the last word, the monster has wriggled free from the phone and is advancing toward her.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Roarrrr—

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Whoaaaa! You-you-you can take your time!
Bianca raises her hands in surrender and tries a new strategy, clumsily attempting to divert the Corruptor's attention.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ha-Haha... Well, it's no coincidence that we found each other in this big city! How about I tell you a story?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: A long, long, long time ago, in Eastside... There was a kindergarten... and in that kindergarten... there was a child... Her... name... was Bianca...

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Purge...!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hold on, I haven't finished yet. She only ate red apples, she went to the female washroom, her favorite pastime in school was tattling to teachers, and when she grew up, she loved drinking apple juice...
Losing patience, the monster whips out its pixelated tentacles instantly, nearly reaching Bianca's throat.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ahhhh... I've been obsessed with blind boxes recently, I know it's a waste of money, but I can't help it. My eyes are naturally blue, I don't wear contacts. Help, I'm running out of things to say. HELP!!!
Out of my way!
